script_text: Pisces, this is not a drift; the week snaps your water-sign intuition into proof. Early week, Venus conjuncts Jupiter in your 5th House Monday, trining Neptune in the 2nd, so romance or money leads land; Mars in the 3rd trines Pluto in the 12th, making calls powerful. Wednesday is toughest because the Gemini New Moon in your 4th squares Saturn in your 1st, so family pressure can stall a 10th-House move. The mid-week turn is that 5th House Venus-Jupiter trine to your ruler Neptune, opening affection and pleasure. Late week, Mercury in Gemini squares Saturn. Mars supports money talks; Moon in Leo in your 6th asks you to finish one task. Best day: Monday is your power day because Venus conjuncts Jupiter in your 5th House. Worst day: Wednesday because the 4th-House New Moon squares Saturn. Weekly advice: send the proposal, protect sleep. Follow for daily updates.
